maria.c: Just finished kubeadm bootstrap for ap-south2 baremetal GPU cluster. Core-addons smoke is failing before handoff — metrics-server CrashLoopBackOff, calico-node flapping on 2 masters, and nvidia-device-plugin DS showing Pending on 2 worker nodes. Need quick sync + a concise handoff checklist so SRE can take over.

jin: Can you paste `kubectl get pods -A` and `kubectl describe node gpu-worker-03` output? Also which kube-proxy mode did we set (iptables/ipvs)?

maria.c: Pasting trimmed outputs: 
```
$ kubectl get pods -A
NAMESPACE     NAME                                     READY   STATUS             RESTARTS   AGE
kube-system   metrics-server-7b9f8f6d7-9xq2p          0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   5          8m
kube-system   calico-node-abcde                        0/1     CrashLoopBackOff   3          9m
kube-system   nvidia-device-plugin-daemonset-xyz       0/1     Pending            0          7m
calico-system calico-node-zzzzz                        1/1     Running            0          9m
```
and node describe snippet: 
```
Name: gpu-worker-03
Taints: node.kubernetes.io/memory-pressure:NoSchedule
Non-terminated Pods: 12
Allocatable: nvidia.com/gpu=4
Events:
  Warning  FailedScheduling  1m (x3 over 6m)  default-scheduler  0/5 nodes are available: 1 node(s) had taints, 2 node(s) didn't have free ports, 2 node(s) didn't match node affinity.
```

jin: Ok a few things stand out: 1) Pending DS + affinity — check the device-plugin nodeSelector/affinity. 2) taint on worker-03 is memory-pressure, that could be from kubelet eviction thresholds or a leaking process. 3) metrics-server CrashLoop often due to certs or RBAC; `kubectl logs` of the pod will show API server auth errors. Also confirm kube-proxy mode: `kubectl -n kube-system get ds kube-proxy -o yaml | grep mode`

infra-bot: nvidia-driver-auto-deploy: node gpu-worker-01 OK, gpu-worker-02 OK, gpu-worker-03 FAILED (apt timeout), gpu-worker-04 OK, gpu-worker-05 FAILED (kernel-module mismatch)

taylor_ops: @maria.c quick checklist for handoff we always run:
- Verify node labels: `kubectl get nodes --show-labels | grep gpu` (should be `gpu=true` or `instance-type=<gpu-type>`)
- Check taints/affinities: remove transient memory-pressure taint after investigating (`kubectl taint nodes node-xyz node.kubernetes.io/memory-pressure:NoSchedule-`)
- Ensure nvidia drivers present on nodes: `lsmod | grep nvidia` and `systemctl status nvidia-persistenced`
- Confirm device-plugin DS running on all schedulable nodes and `kubectl logs` for failures
- Calico: ensure IP pool mode fits baremetal (BGP or VXLAN) and `calicoctl node status` shows ready
- Metrics-server: check ClusterRoleBinding and certs (`kubectl describe deployment metrics-server -n kube-system`)
- Pre-pull heavy images for first-day jobs, set imagePullPolicy appropriately

samir_k: Add to that: storageclass default set, CSI nodes healthy, coredns ready, kube-proxy sync with iptables/ipvs — mismatch will cause service flaps. For calico on baremetal we usually switch to VXLAN overlay if BGP peering is not configured, e.g. patch the `FelixConfiguration` or IPPool: 
```sh
kubectl patch ippools default -n calico-system --type merge -p '{"spec":{"vxlanMode":"Always"}}'
# or edit Calico IPPool to set encapsulation to VXLan
```
Also check BIRD logs if using BGP.

maria.c: infra-bot noted two failures — apt timeout and kernel-module mismatch on two nodes. I'll reprovision those nodes with the corrected image (kernel headers + nvidia drivers baked) and remove the memory-pressure taint after fix. Question: any short smoke command we can run to validate GPU stack and addons in one go?

jin: We use a tiny smoke script. Example: 
```sh
kubectl run --rm -i --tty gpu-test --image=nvidia/cuda:11.0-base --limits='nvidia.com/gpu=1' --restart=Never -- /bin/bash -c "nvidia-smi && curl -sS https://10.96.0.1:443/healthz"
```
Steps: ensure DS is running, run this on each node via nodeSelector/affinity. Also a quick metrics-server check: `kubectl top nodes` should return metrics.

taylor_ops: Also for handoff doc include capacity & cost notes: two nodepools — gp-training (spot, autoscale 0-10, gtx-4090 equiv), gp-serving (reserved, min 2, p99 latency targets). Set cluster-autoscaler with expander priority to prefer spot for training. Add alert if >30% of GPUs are on spot eviction in 5m.

samir_k: Final pre-handoff checklist snippet to add to PR: 
- Drivers installed and `nvidia-smi` OK on all nodes
- device-plugin DS Ready on all schedulable nodes
- taints/labels consistent and documented
- calico in stable mode for region (VXLAN if no BGP)
- metrics-server not crashing, `kubectl top` works
- default StorageClass present and PVC provisioning smoke-tested
- RBAC + audit logging enabled
- Autoscaler configured per nodepool with bounds and GPU metrics exported to prometheus
- cost tags on nodepools and cloud billing alerts configured

maria.c: Great — I'll reprovision the 2 nodes, re-run the driver deploy, switch Calico to VXLAN for now, and then run the smoke script across all GPU nodes. Will post `kubectl get pods -A` and `kubectl top nodes` after. Thanks y'all :thumbsup:
